book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第一册
unit_cn: Unit 4 Meeting the Muse 与灵感相遇
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修一 Unit 4 词表(真词)+ 本单元课文(艺术家与灵感/艺术与科技/艺术展)主题真词;IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、艺术与灵感主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Nature can inspire an artist to create something new.
words.example_cn: 大自然能启发艺术家创作新作品。

words.meaning_cn: 灵感;启发;鼓舞人心的人或事
words.example_en: For many artists, childhood is a rich source of inspiration.
words.example_cn: 对许多艺术家来说,童年是丰富的灵感来源。

words.example_en: The famous artist found his ideas in his children's toys.
words.example_cn: 这位著名艺术家从孩子的玩具里找到了创意。

words.example_en: Every artist's wish is to create something that expresses an idea.
words.example_cn: 每位艺术家的心愿都是创作能表达某种思想的作品。

words.example_en: With new tools, we can take part in the creation of art.
words.example_cn: 借助新工具,我们能参与艺术的创作。

words.example_en: Technology helps more people explore their creative side.
words.example_cn: 科技帮助更多人发掘自己的创造力。

words.example_en: People have used art to express their thoughts for thousands of years.
words.example_cn: 数千年来,人们一直用艺术表达自己的思想。

words.example_en: Tan Dun believes music carries a universal expression of the human spirit.
words.example_cn: 谭盾认为音乐承载着人类精神的普遍表达。

words.meaning_cn: 影响;影响力;对……产生影响
words.example_en: His music mixes Chinese traditions with Western influences.
words.example_cn: 他的音乐把中国传统与西方影响融合在一起。

words.example_en: Yang Liping's passion is dancing, and her dances come from folk traditions.
words.example_cn: 杨丽萍的热爱是舞蹈,她的舞蹈源自民间传统。

words.example_en: The Dai people admire the peacock as a symbol of natural beauty.
words.example_cn: 傣族人把孔雀视为自然之美而加以欣赏。

words.example_en: In the dance, the peacock is said to represent the beauty of nature.
words.example_cn: 在这支舞里,孔雀被认为象征着自然之美。

words.example_en: Her dances grow out of the tradition of her own people.
words.example_cn: 她的舞蹈是从本民族的传统中生长出来的。

words.example_en: The dancer draws on the traditional belief of the Dai people.
words.example_cn: 这位舞者借鉴了傣族人的传统信仰。

words.example_en: His art comes from a deep belief in the power of nature.
words.example_cn: 他的艺术源于对自然之力的坚定信念。

words.example_en: Tan Dun is widely known for composing music for famous films.
words.example_cn: 谭盾因为著名电影作曲而广为人知。

words.example_en: The Chinese composer tells stories through a mix of sounds.
words.example_cn: 这位中国作曲家通过混合各种声音来讲述故事。

words.example_en: He hopes his music has a universal meaning for the whole world.
words.example_cn: 他希望自己的音乐对全世界都有普遍的意义。

words.example_en: Great art often speaks to the human spirit.
words.example_cn: 伟大的艺术常常能触动人类的精神。

words.example_en: His large sculpture of a duck is on display all over the world.
words.example_cn: 他那座巨大的鸭子雕塑在世界各地展出。

words.example_en: Some famous paintings are rarely on display to the public.
words.example_cn: 一些名画很少向公众展出。

words.example_en: The huge fish was set among the beautiful landscape of a water town.
words.example_cn: 那条巨大的鱼被安放在水乡的美丽景观之中。

words.example_en: The folk tale had been passed down through the generations.
words.example_cn: 这个民间故事代代相传。

words.example_en: A new exhibition on abstract art is on at the museum this week.
words.example_cn: 本周博物馆正在举办一场抽象艺术展。

words.example_en: Which artwork makes the greatest impression on you?
words.example_cn: 哪件艺术品给你的印象最深?

words.example_en: Abstract art does not always show real objects.
words.example_cn: 抽象艺术并不总是描绘真实的物体。

words.example_en: The artist created a strong contrast between light and dark.
words.example_cn: 这位艺术家在明暗之间制造了强烈的对比。

words.example_en: She uses innovative methods to make her installations.
words.example_cn: 她用创新的方法来制作她的装置作品。

words.example_en: We discussed the innovation behind these new art forms.
words.example_cn: 我们讨论了这些新艺术形式背后的创新。

words.example_en: Digital painting has become a new trend in the art world.
words.example_cn: 数字绘画已成为艺术界的一种新潮流。

words.meaning_cn: 清晰的;截然不同的;明显的
words.example_en: New tools make the line between art and technology less distinct.
words.example_cn: 新工具让艺术与科技之间的界限不再那么分明。

words.example_en: Millions of people have enjoyed a digital version of the old painting.
words.example_cn: 数百万人欣赏过这幅古画的数字版本。

words.example_en: The museum showed a moving version of the famous scroll.
words.example_cn: 博物馆展出了这幅名卷的动态版本。

words.meaning_cn: 可接触到的;易理解的;可使用的
words.example_en: Technology has made art more accessible to ordinary people.
words.example_cn: 科技让艺术对普通人来说更容易接触。

words.example_en: His style is a combination of Chinese and Western ideas.
words.example_cn: 他的风格是中西方思想的结合。

words.example_en: Technological advances have changed the art world greatly.
words.example_cn: 科技的进步极大地改变了艺术界。

words.example_en: These sights set his idea for the artwork in motion.
words.example_cn: 这些景象让他创作这件作品的想法开始萌动。

words.example_en: The article used a quote from the artist about his own work.
words.example_cn: 文章引用了这位艺术家谈论自己作品的一句话。

words.example_en: His inspiration came from old Chinese folk tales.
words.example_cn: 他的灵感来自古老的中国民间故事。

words.example_en: The old tale about a fish jumping the Dragon Gate inspired him.
words.example_cn: 鱼跃龙门的古老传说给了他灵感。

words.example_en: The map was made entirely of wire and cables.
words.example_cn: 这幅地图完全由金属丝和电缆制成。

words.meaning_cn: 确实地;真正地;字面上地
words.example_en: Visitors could literally change the colours of the artwork with their phones.
words.example_cn: 参观者真的能用手机改变这件作品的颜色。

words.example_en: Yang Liping feels grateful for the years she spent in Yunnan.
words.example_cn: 杨丽萍对自己在云南度过的岁月心怀感激。

words.example_en: It is astonishing to see a world map made entirely of cables.
words.example_cn: 看到一幅完全由电缆做成的世界地图,真是令人惊叹。

words.meaning_cn: 惊人的;激动人心的;令人屏息的
words.example_en: The installation named Superhighway is truly breathtaking.
words.example_cn: 那件名为《超级高速公路》的装置作品着实令人叹为观止。

words.example_en: The floating lights at night fascinate every visitor.
words.example_cn: 夜里漂浮的灯光让每位参观者着迷。
